desc: Derive the correct cost formula: answer = Σ_v (v−r_v)(v+r_v−1)/2 with r_v = #{x ≤ v : pos_x ≤ pos_v}; strategy = process values decreasing, move each rightward; per-cut lower bound #{v>j : r_v ≤ j} achieved by greedy; verified on all samples and extra cases.
Design the BIT algorithm: single Fenwick over positions; for v = 1..N: r_v = query(pos_v); ans += (v−r_v)(v+r_v−1)/2; add(pos_v). O(N log N).
Verify formula on edge cases: sorted → 0, N=2 reversed → 1, fully decreasing → closed form consistent.
Implement final Python solution: fast I/O via sys.stdin.buffer, iterative Fenwick, O(N log N), 64-bit-safe answer; code matches the verified formula and is presented in the required delimiters.
